headline: JP Morgan Maintains Overweight on Ralph Lauren, Raises Price Target to $452
summary: JP Morgan  analyst Matthew Boss   maintains Ralph Lauren (NYSE:RL) with a Overweight and raises the price target from $434 to $452.
